editorial.blurb: This hidden basement spot delivers authentic Hainanese chicken rice with tender poached chicken, fragrant broth-cooked rice, and three perfectly balanced dipping sauces that make the dish sing.
editorial.insiderTip: Hunt for it in the basement food court near Chinatown during weekday lunch when it's quieter; order the poached version for the most authentic experience, and don't skip the youtiao with soymilk as a perfect pairing.
